about: External data for the validation suites. node validation/fetch.mjs downloads each file into validation/cache/<dataset>/ and checks its SHA-256. The files are not part of the repository or of the CytoWeave program; each keeps its own licence.

gatingml.title: Gating-ML 2.0 compliance test suite (ISAC)
gatingml.description: Gating-ML 2.0 gate files with list-mode data and the expected membership of every event in every gate, as distributed in the Bioconductor package gatingMLData (J. Spidlen, N. Gopalakrishnan).
gatingml.licence: Distributed by ISAC for testing Gating-ML compliance; the Bioconductor package is GPL. CytoWeave downloads it for testing and does not redistribute it.

flowkit.title: FlowKit 1.3.2 test data
flowkit.description: FlowJo 10 workspaces with their FCS files (an 8-colour intracellular cytokine panel; synthetic diamond and line examples), compensation and spectral reference events, and FCS files from several instruments, as used by FlowKit's own tests.
flowkit.licence: Part of FlowKit's repository (BSD-3-Clause); the provenance of the real data files is not documented there. CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

fcsparser.title: fcsparser test files
fcsparser.description: FCS files from several instruments (Cytek xP5, BD FACSCalibur, LSR II and Fortessa, Miltenyi MACSQuant in FCS 2.0, 3.0 and 3.1, Guava Muse with several data sets, CyFlow Cube 8) and deliberately malformed files. FACS_Diva/facs_diva_test.fcs is left out: it appears to be a clinical panel of unknown origin.
fcsparser.licence: MIT (© 2018 Eugene Yurtsev). CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

rpackages.title: Example data of the R packages PeacoQC, FlowSOM and CytoNorm
rpackages.description: PeacoQC's 111.fcs; FlowSOM's 68983.fcs with the FlowJo workspace gated on it; CytoNorm's six control files (three batches, the same two volunteers in each).
rpackages.licence: Distributed with GPL-licensed R packages. CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

zenodo-skull.title: Skull bone marrow chimera: compensation controls and two samples (Zenodo 22808501)
zenodo-skull.description: Single-stain compensation controls of a BD LSRFortessa panel and two bone-marrow samples, from "Example of skull bone marrow chimera using congenic mice".
zenodo-skull.licence: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.
